verification.note: Reproduced by reading the code. In addons/knowledge/frontend/MarkdownEditor.tsx:392-411 the paste handler is registered in all modes. Nothing at lines 325-337 or 360-413 gates it on plainText. It collects the clipboard items whose type starts with image/. When any are present it calls event.preventDefault() (line 404), then callbackRef.current.onPasteImages?.(...), and returns true, so CodeMirror never handles the event. Editor.tsx:1432 passes onPasteImages={plainText ? undefined : handlePasteImages}, so in plain-text mode the optional call does nothing. A clipboard that carries text/plain plus an image/* item therefore inserts neither, even though the text was pasted as text. That breaks I4: 'the only text inserted is what the viewer typed or pasted as text'. It happens in normal use: copying cells from a spreadsheet, or rich content from some apps, puts both text and image representations on the clipboard. The handler itself is pre-existing; reaching it from plain-text mode is new on this branch.

specification_compliance: I4 is broken for a mixed text-plus-image clipboard in plain-text mode (R3-1).
The drop handler at MarkdownEditor.tsx:372-391 also calls preventDefault whenever files are present. With onDropFiles undefined, dropping a file uploads nothing and inserts nothing, which matches I4.
regression_risks: A fix that gates the image branch on onPasteImages being defined (or on !plainText) must still keep the Markdown mode's image upload on paste.
test_coverage: No test covers a paste whose clipboard carries both text/plain and image/* items in plain-text mode.
not_verified: I did not run any tests or check the behaviour in a real browser; this was verified by reading the code only.
I did not check which real-world clipboard sources put an image item next to text.
